hook: The referral message that *actually gets replies*

slides.title: Don't open with "Hi sir, please refer"
slides.body: Strangers ignore it. Give them a reason and make it easy.

slides.title: Line 1: connection
slides.body: "Hi Priya, I saw your post about the analyst team at your company."

slides.title: Line 2-3: proof
slides.body: "I'm a 2026 B.Tech grad, built a sales dashboard in Power BI for our college fest."

slides.title: Line 4: tiny ask + job link
slides.body: "Would you be open to referring me for this role? Resume attached. Thank you!"

cta: Comment INTERVIEW and practise the interview that comes after the referral - free.
caption:
Referrals get you noticed faster than a cold application - but only if your message is easy to say yes to.

Connection → proof → tiny ask + job link. Keep it under 80 words.

Save this template 📌 and send 3 messages this week.

💬 Comment INTERVIEW for free AI interview practice once they say yes.
keyword_reply: Here you go! 🎯 Practise this with a free AI mock interview + speaking score at vocalisai.vercel.app (link in bio). Tell me your score!
